summaries.en: nvm is a Node Version Manager that solves the common problem of needing different Node.js versions for various projects. It works as a POSIX-compliant bash script that manages multiple Node.js installations, allowing seamless switching between versions. You can install specific versions, set default versions per project using .nvmrc files, and test applications across different Node.js releases to ensure compatibility.
summaries.zh: nvm 是一个 Node.js 版本管理器，解决了开发者在不同项目中需要切换 Node.js 版本的常见难题。它通过 POSIX 兼容的 bash 脚本实现多版本管理，能够轻松安装、切换和测试不同版本的 Node.js 运行环境。开发者可以为每个项目创建 .nvmrc 文件指定所需版本，确保团队协作和环境一致性，还能方便地测试应用在不同 Node.js 版本下的兼容性表现，大大简化了多版本管理的复杂性。

summaries.en: The Data Engineer Handbook is a comprehensive GitHub repository that serves as a curated guide for learning data engineering, addressing the challenge of navigating scattered resources. It organizes essential concepts, tools, and tutorials—covering Apache Spark, SQL, and big data—into a structured collection of Jupyter Notebooks and links. You can use it as a self-study roadmap, reference specific topics like data pipelines, or extend it by contributing practical examples to help others master real-world data workflows.
summaries.zh: 《数据工程师手册》是一个GitHub上的开源项目，它通过系统化整理数据工程领域的学习资源，解决了初学者和从业者面对知识碎片化的难题。该项目以Jupyter Notebook为核心，将Apache Spark、SQL和大数据技术等关键内容链接成结构化指南，强调实践导向的学习路径。你可以将其作为自学路线图，参考其中的数据管道设计案例，或通过添加实际项目经验来扩展内容，从而快速掌握构建可靠数据系统的核心技能。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
